SELECT
  COUNT(*)                              AS total_municipios,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uf)                    AS total_ufs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE capital)       AS capitais,
  ROUND(MIN(latitude)::numeric, 4)      AS lat_sul,
  ROUND(MAX(latitude)::numeric, 4)      AS lat_norte,
  ROUND(MIN(longitude)::numeric, 4)     AS lon_oeste,
  ROUND(MAX(longitude)::numeric, 4)     AS lon_leste
FROM torre.ref_municipios_brasil;

SELECT
  uf,
  COUNT(*)                              AS municipios,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE capital)       AS capital
FROM torre.ref_municipios_brasil
GROUP BY uf
ORDER BY uf;
